rounds.text: Conceded: the company maintains zero debt [E32], demonstrates strong recent operating cash flow [E29], and posts a high return on capital employed [E10]. However, severe structural and capital allocation risks undermine its superficial attractiveness. Domestic institutional investors have completely abandoned the stock, dropping their stake from 11.45% in March 2022 to 0.00% by July 2026, while total institutional money flow registers a negative signal [E37, E38]. Furthermore, the business refuses to reward shareholders, paying a dividend yield of 0.00% despite reporting repeated profits [E4, E56]. Topline expansion is sluggish over a multi-year horizon, evidenced by a poor compounded sales growth rate of 11.0% over the past five years [E57]. Quality of earnings is also compromised, as reported earnings include a substantial other income component of Rs 7.20 Cr [E58]. Finally, the yearly operating-margin trend is classified as inconsistent over the last three years [E26], and quantitative signals explicitly flag that earnings growth is decelerating [E64].
